maria-partnerships: quick sync — final asset handoff for the cloud marketplace listings (AWS/GCP) + Nutanix joint announcement. Need to lock embargo time, landing page publish, blog timing, and who delivers final files. can we confirm timings? :calendar:
kevin-pm: partners suggested embargo 2025-06-18 16:00 UTC. propose landing page go-live 16:05 UTC, blog post 16:10 UTC, press distribution 16:30 UTC. @ellen-eng can you confirm deploy windows and rollback plan?
ellen-eng: landing page at +5m after embargo works. we'll need final hero image (1920x1080), alt copy, and the marketplace SKU/AMI IDs by EOD 6/17 to wire into CI. also need a short acceptability test plan for partner dry-run.
sam-press: press prefers 16:30 distribution but ok if page is live earlier. biggest ask: no public links before embargo. we'll do outreach to top-tier outlets at 16:35. please confirm final contact list. :loud_sound:
maria-partnerships: @nutanix-sponsor @gcp-partner any constraints on timings or asset delivery windows?
nutanix-sponsor: we can align on 16:00 embargo. request a 15:50 private preview link for validation. also require final joint logo lock by 2025-06-18 12:00 UTC. we'll provide legal signoff on co-brand copy by noon too.
gcp-partner: GCP is good for 16:00 embargo. we need the solution brief PDF and the partner appendix by 2025-06-17 23:59 PT. who will own the PDF final?
elaine-marketing: I can own the solution brief and the blog copy. will produce draft blog + PDF and upload to the shared drive by 6/17 EOD. design, can you confirm you can get hero comp and thumbnails finalized after my copy?
design-bot: design-bot: drafted hero comps uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 - please comment with :+1: or changes, tag @elaine-marketing.
ellen-eng: for marketplace artifacts we'll need the following from each partner: SKU/AMI/VM image IDs, publisher metadata, and test account creds (temp). sample CLI we use for marketplace verification:
```bash
# verify AMI published in account
aws ec2 describe-images --image-ids ami-0abcdef1234567890 --region us-west-2
# sample publish step (internal)
./scripts/publish-marketplace --provider aws --ami ami-0abcdef1234567890 --sku redwood-nutanix-1.0
```
please add real IDs into the spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/marketplace-assets
kevin-pm: checklist recap: 1) hero image + alt (design) 2) solution brief PDF (elaine) 3) SKU/AMI IDs + metadata (partners) 4) private preview link (eng) 5) joint logos + legal signoff (nutanix) 6) exact embargo time (CONFIRMED 2025-06-18 16:00 UTC) 7) press contact list (sam). who's owning the landing page copy final?
elaine-marketing: i will finalize the landing page H1/H2 and CTAs. will push copy to /content/partners/nutanix-redwood by 6/17 22:00 PT. @ellen-eng, tell us where to drop the final images for the deploy pipeline.
ellen-eng: drop into s3://redwood-staging/partner-assets/nutanix/ and i'll pick them up. i'll create a private preview URL and post here ~15:50 UTC on 6/18 per nutanix request. staging deploy will happen 16:00 -> 16:03, then swap to prod at 16:05. rollback plan: revert CDN route if any 16:06-16:10.
sam-press: press embargo note: we'll keep embargo in PR docs and only share contacts in secure thread. @maria-partnerships please DM the contact list for distribution.
nutanix-sponsor: noted. will provide logo pack and final legal text by 12:00 UTC 6/18. also request a short co-authored quote — @kevin-pm can you draft?
kevin-pm: yes, i'll draft a 1-2 sentence partner quote and share for approval by 6/18 09:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created staging preview https://staging.redwood.ai/partners/nutanix-preview (expires 6/19). credentials in 1Password.
elaine-marketing: quick question — for the blog's social card we need a 1200x630 image. design, can you output that variant?
design-bot: design-bot: added export sizes to the Figma file, tagged @elaine-marketing.
maria-partnerships: timeline summary: assets due 6/17 EOD (copy + PDF + images) + partner SKU/metadata asap, private preview 6/18 15:50 UTC, embargo 6/18 16:00 UTC, landing page 16:05, blog 16:10, press distribution 16:30. any blockers? :question:
gcp-partner: no blockers from our side, we will fill marketplace metadata spreadsheet by EOD 6/17.
nutanix-sponsor: minor ask — can we get the staging link a little earlier if possible? will confirm.
ellen-eng: we'll aim for 15:45 preview if design + assets arrive early. otherwise 15:50 stands.
kevin-pm: great. i'll post a short owner matrix in the morning. thanks all. :rocket:
